scope: E3 FE-only resource observation deviations; uniformly applicable before formal TEST release
decision: retain actual returned outcomes and use unchanged external evaluator; no repeated native evaluation
admission: submit only after a strict integer zero foreign-process observation; wait on occupied or unknown GPU without an algorithm deadline
return: foreign or unknown post-return observations are resource deviations; preserve exact original return and observation
timing: affected task timings and whole-run aggregate timings remain labelled; exclude them from uncontaminated speed comparisons
unchanged: host and GPU UUID per resumed run
rationale: count-limited kernels and progress use FE; occupancy observations do not enter solver inputs; native failures still receive the original evaluator's failure score
implementation: standalone recovery entrypoint and independent deviation journal audit; original frozen modules and execution files remain unchanged
